Overview

Minot is a city in ND with a population of 48,000. Magic City with Minot Air Force Base, the Scandinavian Heritage Park, and the State Fair. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.6.
